📰 General

Gold Prices Crash to Year-Low as Oil Prices Intensify Economic Concerns •

Gold prices experienced a significant decline, dropping to a one-year low of below $3,900 per ounce on Friday. The market downturn was primarily driven by rising oil prices, which are fueling anxieties about potential economic hardship. Analysts attribute the sell-off to investors seeking safer assets amid economic uncertainty. This marks a substantial decrease from previous highs and reflects broader market volatility.

🌍 World

Pentagon Advising Trump on Military Options Amidst Midterm Election Pressure •

The Pentagon is currently advising President Donald Trump on potential military options related to Iran. Trump reiterated his previous assertion that the ongoing conflict with Iran will conclude “very soon.” He specifically stated that Iran’s acquisition of a nuclear weapon is unacceptable. This advice comes as the key midterm election deadline approaches, suggesting a heightened sense of urgency within the administration.

🦅 US

Arrowmax Introduces AI-Powered Electric Screwdriver Utilizing Camera and Artificial Intelligence •

Arrowmax is launching a new electric screwdriver, ArrowSpace S1, designed to simplify the process of selecting the correct screwdriver bit. The device incorporates a camera and artificial intelligence to identify the necessary bit based on the screw being used. The system analyzes the screw’s head and transmits this information to the AI, which then directs the screwdriver to the appropriate bit. The company is seeking $350,000 on Kickstarter to finalize development and production of the innovative tool.

💰 Business

Cruise Ship’s “Forever Cruise” Collapse: Internal Docs Reveal Funding Crisis •

Internal documents detail a desperate scramble for funds surrounding the MV Odyssey’s planned “forever cruise,” a voyage intended to circumnavigate the globe. The cruise, which began in Argentina, faced significant financial difficulties within its first three months, leading to repeated attempts to secure investment. Residents were abruptly halted in Cambodia after failing to meet payment obligations and with no clear plan for continued operation. The ship’s operator, Villa Vie, ultimately made the decision to disembark passengers with minimal notice, leaving many stranded.

💻 Technology

Zelda Producer Aonuma Expresses Anxiety Over Ocarina of Time Remake Reception •

Eiji Aonuma, producer of The Legend of Zelda franchise, anticipates the release of the Ocarina of Time remake next week with a notable degree of apprehension. He acknowledges the game’s significant legacy and the high expectations surrounding its updated version. Aonuma has stated that he is particularly concerned about fan reaction given the game’s immense popularity and influence within the gaming industry. The remake aims to modernize the classic adventure while retaining its core gameplay and story elements.

🎭 Entertainment

“You Can See Everything” and “Clayface” Clash at Box Office, Splitting $20 Million •

“You Can See Everything” and “Clayface” are competing for box office dominance this Halloween weekend, with both films generating over $10 million domestically. Initial reports indicate a close race between the A24 horror film and the Warner Bros./DC superhero entry. Current data suggests “You Can See Everything” is slightly ahead, capitalizing on its smaller release and strong early reviews. The films are vying for top position in the Halloween box office revenue.

🏅 Sports

BYU Cougars Face Arizona State in Key Conference Showdown – Broadcast Details Included •

The No. 8 BYU Cougars (6-1, 3-1) will compete against the Arizona State Sun Devils (4-3, 2-2) this Saturday at LaVell Edwards Stadium. Kickoff is scheduled for 1:30 p.m. MDT, and the game will be broadcast on Fox. Fans can also access the game via livestream on foxsports.com/live and through KSL 1160 AM/102.7 FM or BYU Radio Sirius XM 166. The Arizona State team currently leads the series with a record of 12-9-1.

🔬 Science

Ancient Martian Meteorite Unearthed in Sahara Desert Reveals 4.1 Billion Years •

A meteorite discovered in the Sahara Desert’s Mali region has been confirmed by NASA as originating from Mars. The nearly two-pound rock, dubbed Teghaza 001, is estimated to be 4.1 billion years old. Analysis indicates the meteorite’s composition closely matches Martian rocks, providing valuable insights into the planet’s early history. Scientists believe the meteorite was ejected from Mars during a massive impact event.

🩺 Health

Cologuard Positive Result at 85: Understanding Next Steps and Seeking Expert Guidance •

A recent Cologuard test result came back positive for an 85-year-old woman, prompting questions about the significance of the finding and appropriate follow-up. The individual’s gastrointestinal doctor advised against a traditional colonoscopy due to her age, citing potential risks. The test’s positive result necessitates further investigation, as Cologuard detects biomarkers associated with colorectal cancer. Seeking a second opinion and exploring alternative diagnostic strategies are recommended to determine the next course of action.
